Hi Lindsey / Ari,

Appreciate the clarity — attaching a concise inspection playbook (PDF) and a SOC 2 scope summary to get the conversation started. High level summary here:
- Evidence cadence: proposed weekly evidence bundle for first 90 days, then biweekly sampling for ongoing customers; we can make cadence configurable in the exhibit.
- Pen-test: 10 business days notice for full external pentests; we propose staging access, scoped IP ranges, and ephemeral credentials during the window.
- Scope: SOC 2 in-scope systems listed in the attached spreadsheet; we do not expose production PII for direct inspection, only sampled artifacts and redacted logs.

Two quick asks for you: 1) preferred sampling size (e.g., 5–10% of sessions or X artifacts per week) and 2) any internal procurement constraints around notice/windowing. If those are OK we can circulate a short MSA exhibit draft for legal.

If helpful I'll loop in Legal and Security internally this afternoon for suggested redlines.

Best,

Thanks Naomi — drafted suggested redline language below we can drop into Exhibit X (MSA appendix). I kept items short so they fit into the Order Form appendix as requested.

Suggested redlines / notes:
1) Evidence cadence: "Redwood will provide a consolidated evidence bundle covering SOC 2 controls and operational artifacts on a weekly basis for the initial 90-day onboarding period, after which Redwood and Customer will agree a sampling cadence (no less frequently than once every 30 days) unless otherwise agreed in writing."
2) Penetration testing: "Customer shall provide minimum ten (10) business days' notice prior to external penetration testing; Redwood will provide a staging environment and scoped access consistent with the Order Form. Production access will not be permitted without prior written agreement and a signed inspection agreement."
3) Artifacts & redaction: "Redwood will provide redacted logs, control mappings, and relevant report excerpts. PII will be redacted prior to delivery; any production data access request requires Legal approval and a separate data extraction agreement."
4) Audit window & sampling: "Inspection windows will be booked in coordination with Redwood Security; Redwood will offer up to five (5) sample artifacts per evidence bundle by default. For broader forensic inspections, the parties will agree on scope and timing no less than thirty (30) days in advance."
5) Confidentiality & usage: "Evidence provided is Confidential and may only be used for Customer's internal compliance purposes. Customer must not share artifacts with third parties without Redwood's prior consent."

Operational notes for Jordan / CS: can you confirm the five-sample default and that engineering can produce the redacted artifacts within 5 business days of a bundle request? Also thinking we should include a DocuSign template link for the exhibit acceptance to streamline signature.

Karthik
General Counsel | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Inspection consent playbook & MSA delta — SOC 2 / pen-test cadence

Naomi / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the suggested exhibit language. A few clarifying notes from our side:
- Sampling cadence: Clearwell prefers biweekly (every 14 days) after the initial onboarding bundle rather than monthly; biweekly is acceptable operationally for us and keeps audit windows tight.
- Pen-test notice: 10 business days is acceptable, but we also need the option to request a 48-hour emergency window for critical vulnerability scans with an SLA to remediate findings. Is that something Redwood can accept with a defined exception flow?
- Artifacts: the five-sample default sounds good; can you confirm the types of artifacts (config snippets, control evidence, redacted logs) in the exhibit bullet list?

If we can incorporate the biweekly cadence and an emergency scan exception in the exhibit language we can move to sign next week. Happy to approve the one-page appendix once redlines are incorporated.

Best,
Lindsey Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Clearwell Health
